newsitem.title: USA: Provident files for $1.0 mln preferred.
newsitem.headline: Provident files for $1.0 mln preferred.

text.p: Provident Bancorp Inc filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission Friday for $1.0 million in trust preferred securities.
The securities will be offered by Provident Capital Trust I, a business trust owned by Provident Bancorp.

Proceeds from the sale of the preferred securities will be used to buy junior subordinated debentures of the parent. Provident Bancorp, a Cincinnati-based bank holding company, will use proceeds from the sale of the debentures for general corporate purposes.
Such purposes may include repayment of debt, investments in or extensions of credit to subsidiaries and financing of possible acquisitions, Provident Bancorp said.
Lehman Bros. was named underwriter for the offering.
